After high school we started to hang out less due to college/work etc, but we still keep in touch here and there. We were both born and raised in Canada. Just to be clear I WILL eventually be addressing him by Thor once I get used to it. My issue is that I've been calling him Tim for 10 years, and I'm just not used to calling him Thor yet. Whats most likely going to happen is something like this: "Hey Tim! err.. I mean Thor." Knowing his short fuse he wont like this. Am i the asshole here?
